headlines.description: — Travis Konecny scored a milestone goal, Bobby Brink scored the shootout winner and had a goal and an assist and the Philadelphia Flyers defeated the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konecny nets 200th career goal, Brink shines as Flyers edge Penguins in shootout

events.name: Calgary Flames at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Max Domi and Matthew Knies each scored two goals, and the Toronto Maple Leafs topped the Calgary Flames 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Domi and Knies help the Maple Leafs beat the struggling Flames 4-3

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Carolina Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Carolina Hurricanes advance to face Vegas in the Stanley Cup Final, beating Montreal 6-1 in Game 5.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carolina Hurricanes advance to face Vegas in the Stanley Cup Final, beating Montreal 6-1 in Game 5

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Miles Wood scored twice, with his second goal coming 2:53 into overtime, to rally the Columbus Blue Jackets to a 4-3 win over the Buffalo Sabres on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wood scores 2 including winner in return from injury, lifting Blue Jackets to 4-3 win over Sabres

headlines.description: — Troy Terry and Mason McTavish scored in a shootout, and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Florida Panthers 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ducks edge Panthers 3-2 in shootout as Quenneville returns to South Florida

events.name: New York Islanders at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — David Pastrnak had a goal and an assist to help the Boston Bruins rally for a 5-2 victory over the New York Islanders on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pastrnak and Lindholm star as the Bruins rally past the Islanders 5-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Zemgus Girgensons scored two goals to lead the Tampa Bay Lightning to a 5-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zemgus Girgensons scores twice as Lightning down Predators 5-2

headlines.description: — Kyle Connor's wrist shot 46 seconds into overtime gave the Winnipeg Jets a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Tuesday night, their ninth straight win against their Central Division rival.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Connor gets the winner for the Jets just 46 seconds into OT for 4-3 win over Wild

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Dylan Larkin scored twice and Alex DeBrincat also scored to help the Detroit Red Wings beat the St. Louis Blues 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Larkin scores twice to help Red Wings beat Blues 5-2

headlines.description: — Connor Bedard had three goals and an assist in his first career hat trick, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Ottawa Senators 7-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Bedard scores 3 times as the Blackhawks knock off the Senators 7-3

headlines.description: — Jake Oettinger made 24 saves recording his first shutout of the season and Tyler Seguin scored a power-play goal deflected off a Washington defenseman’s stick as the Dallas Stars beat the Capitals 1-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars' Jake Oettinger blanks Ovechkin, Capitals in 1-0 win

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Victor Olofsson had his first career NHL hat trick and added two assists, Nathan MacKinnon scored two goals, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the New Jersey Devils 8-4 on Tuesday night in the second game in three days between the teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Olofsson's five-point game leads Avalanche past Devils, ending New Jersey's win streak

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had a pair of goals and Evan Bouchard added three assists as the Edmonton Oilers exploded for five second-period goals to get past the sizzling Utah Mammoth 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid helps Oilers cool off hot Mammoth with 6-3 win

events.name: New York Rangers at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Jonathan Quick made 23 saves and the New York Rangers blanked the Canucks 2-0 on Tuesday night in captain J.T. Miller's return to Vancouver.
headlines.shortLinkText: Quick gets 64th shutout as Rangers blank Canucks 2-0 in Miller's return to Vancouver

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield set a Montreal franchise record with his 11th career overtime goal, lifting the Canadiens to a 4-3 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Tuesday after they squandered a 3-0 lead midway through the third period.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield sets Canadiens record with 11th career OT goal to beat Kraken 4-3 after 3rd period collapse

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Brandt Clarke scored the tiebreaking goal from the right circle with 6:40 left and the Los Angeles Kings beat the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Tuesday night after blowing a three-goal lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kings blow 3-goal lead but Clarke scores late to beat Sharks 4-3
